## Checklist

- [ ] Change is focused: it does not include unrelated modifications.
- [ ] I ran the relevant test suites (`python -m pytest`, plus the marker suites
      in the README / `docs/development.md`) and they pass.
- [ ] The tests/fixtures baselines were not overwritten silently (regeneration is explicit).
- [ ] Documentation was updated where the change affects user-visible or
      contributor-facing behavior.
- [ ] No generated build/distribution artifacts are committed (`build/`, `dist/`,
      virtual environments, test reports).
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private/personal information are introduced.
- [ ] No conversion behavior was changed incidentally.
